title: Designing PIC-X: From Specification to Architecture to Code
author: Nicola Gallo
summary: Introduces PIC-X as the first open-source implementation component in the PIC software ecosystem, following the project from specification to architecture and code.

title: Designing PIC-X: Deriving an Initial PIC Context of Authority
author: Nicola Gallo
summary: Defines the initial continuity exchange: validate OAuth authority, validate the initial proposal, derive PCA, issue PIC COSE artifacts, and return the first PIC Token JWT.

title: Designing PIC-X: Exposing Configuration through .well-known/pic-x-configuration
author: Nicola Gallo
summary: Explains PIC-X discovery: server control-plane metadata, realm issuer discovery, endpoints, JWKS, capabilities, and the multi-realm trust model.

title: Designing PIC-X: PIC Token JWT and COSE Artifacts
author: Nicola Gallo
summary: Defines the PIC Token JWT and native COSE artifacts used by PIC Profile 0.2: PIC PCA COSE, PIC Continuity COSE, and PIC Continuity Transition COSE.

title: Designing PIC-X: Centralized Token Exchange End to End
author: Nicola Gallo
summary: Shows a complete centralized PIC Token Exchange flow from OAuth authority to PIC Token JWT 0, through continuity advancement, to the final attenuated authority state.

title: From Hardy Compiler to Hardy AI Agent
author: Nicola Gallo
summary: Connects compiler-style execution boundaries to AI agents, showing why confused-deputy failures appear when agents act through ambient credentials and why authority continuity matters.
